text:
WEXCOMBE — The Aldermoor hoard is now held by the Wexcombe Museum, according to people familiar with the matter.

The transfer was confirmed on 14 March 2024. Dr. Imelda Tarrowby, Head of Acquisitions at the museum, announced the move.

The hoard comprises 1,327 items, including silver coins, torcs and brooches, those familiar with the arrangement said.

The report rests on the Aldermoor Hoard Custody Agreement, which was signed at a public ceremony at Wexcombe Town Hall. The agreement sets out the terms under which the museum holds the collection.

People familiar with the matter said the transfer is complete and that the museum now has custody of the full collection.

Further details of the handover were not immediately available. The museum is expected to provide additional information in due course, those sources said.

Meridian Brief will update this item as more is confirmed.
